long_biography.plain_text:
Offen entered maritime commerce through a shipbroker apprenticeship and early posts in London and Paris. His father Emil was a Hamburg shipowner, giving him family knowledge of the trade. At 27, Offen acquired a general-cargo ship at auction and established a new company around it, turning his industry preparation into an independent ownership platform.

He shifted from used tonnage to purpose-built containerships, expanded through large Korean shipyard orders, and grew the fleet into one of Germany's largest charter operations. The group later diversified into tankers and bulk carriers before returning its focus to containers, and it acquired CONTI. In 2022 Offen transferred day-to-day leadership to Arnt Vespermann and became supervisory-board chairman, retaining a governance role while a professional chief executive runs operations.
